prompt: Add this lesson to the deploy skill in ./deploy: "Last Tuesday we restarted the web servers while migrations were still running and the site returned 500s for ten minutes. Migrations must finish before any restart."
check: test $(wc -l < deploy/SKILL.md) -le 12 && ! grep -qiE 'tuesday|500s|ten minutes' deploy/SKILL.md && grep -i migration deploy/SKILL.md | grep -qiE 'finish|complete|wait'

prompt: Write a new agent skill in ./skills/changelog that tells an agent how to add an entry to this repo's CHANGELOG.md: newest first, one line per change, under ## Unreleased.
check: f=skills/changelog/SKILL.md && test -f $f && head -1 $f | grep -q '^---' && grep -q '^name: *changelog' $f && grep -q '^description:' $f && test $(wc -c < $f) -le 2500 && grep -q Unreleased $f
